text: TC[p] is the temporal component of a 4-vector and is transformed into TemporalPair[TemporalMomentum[p], ExplicitLorentzIndex[0]] by FeynCalcInternal.
ExpandScalarProduct is used to expand momenta in TC
ExpandScalarProduct[TC[p - q]] // StandardForm (*TemporalPair[ExplicitLorentzIndex[0], TemporalMomentum[p]] - TemporalPair[ExplicitLorentzIndex[0], TemporalMomentum[q]]*)
